independentReviewFixChecks.scope: 15 new interaction regression tests plus existing shared/advanced checks. Source and test analysis passed; source frozen for coordinator-owned full app/catalog/native verification.
fixes: Collapsed range thumb selection uses logical pointer side or first drag direction, then locks the thumb for that gesture.
Group arrows/Home/End skip unfocusable commands while preserving discoverable disabled reasons.
Combobox restores its actual trigger after pointer-open dismissal, guarded for disabled/detached state.
Date range owns adjacent displayed months separately from selection; standalone date selection still reveals its month.

adaptationDecisions: Reference decorative palette variants intentionally collapse to user-approved Specimen colors rather than reintroducing a broad accent palette.
Arrowed tooltip variants consolidate to the brand arrowless pane; directional placement, supporting body and interactive behavior are implemented.
Reference social/store/provider/flag/photography identity assets are supplied through explicit slots; no invented brand marks or new remote service integrations.
Formatting controls expose every reference command including separate H1/H2, while the app’s editing host owns document semantics and persistence.
